Stunt Stress

Stunt vs No Stunt · Filtered Pass Sample

This chart is play-level and recalculates with the current filters. Pass family prioritizes explicit game-feed/PFF Screen, Quick Game and RPO tags, then uses Play Type for Sprint Out, Play Action and Dropback. The source tags whether a stunt occurred, but does not identify penetrator/looper paths or the specific twist family. No stunt path is drawn unless the source provides it.
